description: Fetches all pages listed in a sitemap.xml and returns DOM-pruned Markdown for each. Ideal for ingesting entire documentation sites into an LLM context with 90%+ token reduction. Handles sitemap indexes (sitemaps of sitemaps) automatically. Use filter_urls to limit to a path prefix (e.g. /docs/, /tutorial/).

filter_urls.description: Optional list of URL prefixes — only pages matching at least one prefix are included.

ignore_errors.description: If true (default), failed page fetches are skipped silently. If false, any fetch error aborts the entire sitemap crawl.

max_pages.description: Max pages to fetch (default 20, max 100). Guards against huge sitemaps.

query.description: Optional BM25 filter query applied to every page.

name: dompruner_sitemap
